Source-linked dynamic records

Overview | Captured source | Execution mapping | Execution and clock groups | Records JSON | Collection plan

Filter by source path, operation, invocation or actor. Occurrence counts retained visits, not necessarily loop iterations. Raw ticks are only comparable within the recorded clock scope; checkpoints record occurrence, not operation busy time. Intervals measure instrumented source control. None means unavailable.

Visit counters are one value per selected site and logical observer. They count reaching a source control position, including masked operations with no active data lanes. They provide no timestamps or busy duration. A saturated count is a lower bound, marked Count exact = False. The census retains all admitted programs in raw data; the default table presents the lowest program with primary-site visits.

Source links open captured snapshots at the measured location. Compiler primary and inline callsite roles are distinct; out-of-range or unavailable positions remain visible as candidates and do not count as located source. File bounds do not independently verify that snapshot text matches compiled text.
